shieldUrl.description: Shield data-plane base URL (policy-pushed; overrides local).

proxyToken.description: Optional Authorization bearer for a fronting proxy/gateway (policy-pushed; overrides local).

deviceId.description: Device / asset identifier injected by MDM policy, e.g. ${machine_name} or an asset tag.

userId.description: User identifier injected by MDM policy (employee id, AD account, or email — the org's choice). Drives the Telemetry agent column.

timeoutMs.description: Screening deadline for a text screen in milliseconds (default 45000; a cloud screen measures 14-20s, so a shorter deadline aborts ordinary requests; file screens add 2000/MB). Clamped to 1000-120000.

failOpen.description: If Shield cannot be reached in enforce mode: false (default) blocks the prompt, true sends it unscreened. A timeout is not an approval.
